reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, isDailyWeekendSkip, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the months day helpers rather than re-deriving any of them.

duplication.why: The occurrence pipeline (RSchedule + captureBreadcrumb wrapper, drop daily weekend days, move other weekend days unless daily-skip) is a third copy of the composition already in getUpcomingDates and getNextDate, rather than one shared 'final day of an occurrence' function.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like it; the weekend-adjustment composition would fit better in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Typed, readable and explicit about the lookaround window, but a future weekend-rule change must be mirrored in three places.
